name: Large clique subdivisions in a pinned graph
description: construct() -> {'branches': distinct vertices, 'paths': one simple path for each unordered pair of branches}. Path endpoints must be their branch pair; all path interiors must be pairwise disjoint and avoid every branch. All consecutive path vertices must be adjacent in the pinned graph. Maximize number of branch vertices. A local G(24,0.4) sample (random.Random(585)) is pinned. A certificate is a lower bound on this host’s largest subdivision order; no theorem about all chromatic graphs or reproduction of the paper’s proof is claimed.

sources.locator: Jacob Fox, Choongbum Lee and Benny Sudakov, Chromatic number, clique subdivisions, and the conjectures of Hajós and Erdős–Fajtlowicz (2011 preprint). Abstract defines sigma(G), the largest clique-subdivision order, and studies its relation to chromatic number.
